title: Odysseys: Benchmarking Web Agents on Realistic Long Horizon Tasks
authors_zh: Lawrence Keunho Jang、Jing Yu Koh、Daniel Fried、Ruslan Salakhutdinov
paper_type_zh: 长程实时网页智能体评测基准与 rubric 数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究长程 computer-use、细粒度轨迹评估、LLM judge、实时网页重放与环境审计的读者
one_line: Odysseys releases 200 live-web tasks with 1,225 rubric checkpoints and an OSWorld/Gemini scoring pipeline, but not the 2,380 source histories, complete model trajectories, human labels, frozen sites, or deterministic replay state.
Odysseys 公开 200 个长程实时网页任务、1,225 条 rubric 和 200 份 OSWorld 配置及评分脚本，但没有公开来源浏览历史、完整模型轨迹、人工标签或可确定重放的网页状态。
why: It replaces one holistic pass/fail judgment with checkpoint-level episode feedback over screenshots and actions, exposing partial progress and efficiency on multi-site tasks while making environment drift, judge dependence, incomplete- run handling, and absent rollout lineage explicit reuse risks.
inclusion_reason: Odysseys defines a long-horizon live-web environment object, a released state/action-compatible task schema, and a fine-grained episode feedback contract based on per-rubric screenshot/action judgment; its missing source journeys, complete rollouts, reset state, and replay bundle are central audit boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing web-agent benchmarks often emphasize short, single-site tasks and one terminal success signal. Odysseys targets multi-site work that may require research, comparison, synthesis, and creation of a persistent deliverable across dozens of browser/VM interactions. A single holistic pass/fail label cannot expose which requirements were met, which phase failed, or whether an agent made useful partial progress.

The released evaluation object is 200 task records with 1,225 rubric checkpoints. Each task has a SHA-1 ID, conversational instruction, starting URL, reference step count, difficulty, SimilarWeb categories, and 3–12 rubrics; each rubric has a requirement and a verification description. The mixture is 45 easy, 46 medium, and 109 hard tasks, with a mean of 6.1 rubrics.

This is not a released trajectory corpus. The repository contains the 200 task/rubric rows, 200 generated OSWorld task configs, a converter, and scoring code. The 2,380 labeled participant journeys, the 696 retained journey labels, full model action histories, chronological screenshots, results, and human-agreement labels are not public. The appropriate training_use is therefore evaluation only.

现有网页智能体基准常偏重短程、单站点任务，并只提供一个终止成功信号。Odysseys 面向多站点长程工作，任务可能需要研究、比较、综合信息，并经过数十次浏览器或虚拟机交互生成持久化交付物。单一整体通过/失败标签无法说明哪些要求已满足、哪个阶段失败，或智能体是否取得了有用的部分进展。

公开的评测对象是 200 条任务记录和 1,225 个 rubric 检查点。每个任务包含 SHA-1 ID、对话式指令、起始 URL、参考步数、难度、SimilarWeb 类别和 3–12 条 rubric；每条 rubric 含要求及验证说明。任务分布为 45 个 easy、46 个 medium、109 个 hard，平均 6.1 条 rubric。

这不是公开的轨迹语料。仓库包含 200 条任务/rubric 记录、200 份生成的 OSWorld 任务配置、转换器和评分代码；2,380 条参与者标注 journey、筛选后 696 条 journey 标签、完整模型动作历史、时序截图、结果和人工一致性标签均未公开。因此，合适的 training_use 仅为 evaluation。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Odysseys decomposes long-horizon completion into task-specific observable checkpoints. During evaluation, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview receives one rubric at a time together with the full action history and chronological screenshots. It returns a textual rationale and binary success/failure for that checkpoint. The unweighted mean of rubric outcomes gives partial credit; perfect is 1 only when every rubric passes, and trajectory efficiency is the mean rubric score divided by environment steps.

The task source attempts to preserve realistic intent. Authors report collecting 2,380 labeled Chrome journeys from 248 consenting Prolific participants in the US and UK, filtering them to 696 retained journey labels, and composing 90 tasks. Another 30 tasks come from authors' real personal queries, while GPT-5.4 generates 80 hard tasks from journey-inspired seeds under human review.

This feedback contract is judgment-required rather than executable verification. Released OSWorld configs deliberately set the native evaluator to infeasible; the external multimodal Gemini judge supplies the score. Rubric-level judgment reveals partial progress, but it remains sensitive to screenshot coverage, judge drift, and omitted state.

Odysseys 把长程任务完成度分解为任务特定、可观察的检查点。评测时，Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview 每次接收一条 rubric，以及完整动作历史和按时间排序的截图，并为该检查点输出文字理由与二元成功/失败。各 rubric 结果的无权平均提供部分得分；仅当所有 rubric 通过时 perfect 才为 1；轨迹效率则等于平均 rubric 得分除以环境步数。

任务来源试图保留真实意图。作者报告从美国和英国 248 名知情同意的 Prolific 参与者处收集 2,380 条已标注 Chrome journey，筛选保留 696 条 journey 标签，并据此组合 90 个任务；另有 30 个任务来自作者真实个人查询，GPT-5.4 再从 journey 启发的种子生成 80 个 hard 任务并经人工审核。

该反馈契约需要判断，而非可执行验证。公开 OSWorld 配置刻意将原生 evaluator 设为 infeasible，实际分数由外部多模态 Gemini judge 提供。逐 rubric 判断能暴露部分进展，但仍受截图覆盖、judge 漂移和不可见状态影响。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with participant journey labels, not released browser histories. An LLM screens label accuracy, feasibility, login requirements, and quality; authors manually review candidates, leaving 696 of 2,380 journeys (29.2%). Labels are embedded with text-embedding-3-small, reduced with UMAP, clustered with HDBSCAN, and connected in a theme graph. For composed tasks, a seed cluster is sampled, one or two breadth-first hops collect 3–6 related clusters, and 3–4 representative journeys per cluster are supplied to GPT-5.4 to select and order a subset.

Final QA removes login-gated or low-quality tasks, requires at least two sites, complete rubrics, coherence of at least 2/5, observable evidence, natural computer-use wording, no PII, and author adjudication. A source journey may be reused at most three times. Exact seeds, clustering parameters, cluster assignments, source-to-task mappings, and rejection manifests are absent.

At evaluation time, a computer-use agent operates Chrome and other capabilities in an Ubuntu OSWorld2 VM with live Internet. Default experiments allow up to 100 environment steps; selected scaling runs use 200. Runs are expected to contain steps.jsonl or traj.jsonl, referenced screenshots, and normally a numeric result.txt. The scorer extracts chronological actions and screenshots, calls Gemini separately for all rubrics, and writes rubric results and aggregates.

Public configs launch Chrome and socat, set proxy=false, fixed_ip=false, and mark possibility_of_env_change=high. The exact OSWorld commit, VM image, browser build, dependency set, API snapshot, network locale, credentials, reset semantics, and site state are not pinned. Although construction appendices mention rubric weights, public tasks omit them and the scorer uses an unweighted mean.

构造从参与者 journey 标签开始，而非从公开浏览历史开始。LLM 按标签准确性、可行性、登录要求和质量筛选，作者再人工复核，最终从 2,380 条 journey 中保留 696 条，即 29.2%。标签用 text-embedding-3-small 嵌入，经 UMAP 降维和 HDBSCAN 聚类后连接成主题图。组合任务会随机选一个种子簇，沿广度优先搜索走 1–2 跳，收集 3–6 个相关簇及每簇 3–4 条代表 journey，再由 GPT-5.4 选择并排序子集。

最终 QA 会移除需登录或低质量任务，要求至少涉及两个站点、rubric 完整、连贯性至少 2/5、证据可观察、computer-use 表述自然、无 PII，并由作者裁决标记问题。每条来源 journey 最多复用三次。精确随机种子、聚类参数、簇分配、来源到任务映射和拒绝清单均未公开。

评测时，computer-use 智能体在带实时互联网的 Ubuntu OSWorld2 VM 中操作 Chrome 及其他能力。默认实验上限为 100 个环境步，部分扩展实验使用 200 步。运行目录预期包含 steps.jsonl 或 traj.jsonl、引用的截图，通常还需数值型 result.txt。评分器提取时序动作和截图，逐 rubric 调用 Gemini，再写出逐项结果和汇总。

公开配置启动 Chrome 与 socat，设置 proxy=false、fixed_ip=false，并标记 possibility_of_env_change=high。OSWorld 精确提交、VM 镜像、浏览器版本、依赖、API 快照、网络区域、凭据、重置语义及站点状态均未固定。构造附录虽提到 rubric 权重，公开任务却不含权重，评分器实际采用无权平均。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release scale was checked directly: 200 task rows, 1,225 rubric records, and 200 generated OSWorld config files. The paper's difficulty counts—45 easy, 46 medium, and 109 hard—match the public JSON. These artifacts make task wording, rubric requirements, starting URLs, and environment launch settings inspectable, but they do not expose the episodes used for the paper's result table.

Author-reported main results give Opus 4.6 a 68.9 rubric average, 44.5 perfect score, and 81.3 steps; GPT-5.4 obtains 55.4, 33.5, and 64.4, respectively, and the best reported trajectory efficiency of 1.15. With a 200-step cap, Opus perfect success rises from 44.5% to 76.5%, while 29 of 200 runs still reach the cap. These values demonstrate test-time scaling under the authors' setup, not deterministic replay.

For 120 Opus 4.6 trajectories, author-reported agreement between rubric evaluation and humans is Cohen's kappa 0.788 with F1 0.949 for averaged rubric outcomes and kappa 0.849 with F1 0.934 for perfect success. A holistic Online-Mind2Web-style judgment reaches kappa 0.508 and F1 0.762. The comparison supports checkpoint decomposition, but trajectory IDs, annotator-level labels, and adjudication records are unavailable.

The public scorer skips directories without a numeric result.txt by default unless --include-incomplete is used. Consequently, published aggregates cannot be independently audited for crash, timeout, empty-action, missing-screenshot, and incomplete-run accounting without the missing run corpus.

发布规模已直接核验：200 条任务记录、1,225 条 rubric 记录和 200 份生成的 OSWorld 配置。论文给出的难度数量——45 个 easy、46 个 medium、109 个 hard——与公开 JSON 一致。这些制品使任务表述、rubric 要求、起始 URL 和环境启动设置可检查，但不包含论文结果表所用的实际回合。

作者报告的主结果中，Opus 4.6 的 rubric 平均分为 68.9、perfect 为 44.5、平均 81.3 步；GPT-5.4 分别为 55.4、33.5 和 64.4，并取得最高轨迹效率 1.15。把上限扩展到 200 步后，Opus 的 perfect 从 44.5% 提高到 76.5%，但仍有 29/200 次运行触及步数上限。这些数值说明作者环境中的测试时扩展效果，而非确定性重放。

在 120 条 Opus 4.6 轨迹上，作者报告 rubric 评估与人工对平均 rubric 结果的一致性为 Cohen's kappa 0.788、F1 0.949，对 perfect 成功的一致性为 kappa 0.849、F1 0.934。整体 Online-Mind2Web 风格判断仅达到 kappa 0.508、F1 0.762。该比较支持检查点分解，但轨迹 ID、逐标注者标签和裁决记录没有公开。

公开评分器默认跳过缺少数值型 result.txt 的目录，只有使用 --include-incomplete 才会纳入。因此，在缺少完整运行语料时，无法独立审计论文汇总如何处理崩溃、超时、空动作、缺失截图和不完整运行。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Odysseys combines three elements that are often separate: long-horizon tasks grounded in browsing behavior, multi-site computer-use execution in a common VM, and checkpoint-level multimodal judging. The rubric contract can distinguish partial accomplishment from complete success without requiring one bespoke programmatic evaluator per live website.

Its task construction also mixes 90 journey-composed tasks, 30 manually authored personal-query tasks, and 80 human-reviewed GPT-5.4 hard tasks. This creates broader intent than a purely templated benchmark, while retaining explicit requirements and verification descriptions for all 1,225 checkpoints.

The contribution is an evaluation surface, not a released post-training trajectory dataset or a new verifier with guaranteed correctness. The native OSWorld evaluator is marked infeasible; Gemini judgments are model-mediated. Rubric decomposition improves audit granularity but does not remove live-web drift, incomplete observability, or judge calibration risk.

Odysseys 把三个通常分离的要素结合起来：以真实浏览行为为来源的长程任务、统一虚拟机中的多站点 computer-use 执行，以及逐检查点的多模态判断。rubric 契约能区分部分完成与完全成功，同时无需为每个实时网站单独编写程序化 evaluator。

任务构造还混合了 90 个 journey 组合任务、30 个人工编写的真实个人查询任务，以及 80 个经人工审核的 GPT-5.4 hard 任务。相较纯模板基准，这能提供更广的意图，同时为全部 1,225 个检查点保留显式要求与验证说明。

其贡献是评测面，而不是公开的后训练轨迹数据集，也不是具有正确性保证的新验证器。原生 OSWorld evaluator 被标为 infeasible，实际依赖 Gemini 模型判断。rubric 分解提高了审计粒度，但不能消除实时网页漂移、不完全可观察性或 judge 校准风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Release boundaries are substantial. Raw participant histories, the 696 retained journey labels, item-level source mappings, rejection decisions, cluster assignments, complete successful and failed model trajectories, screenshots, result files, Gemini responses, and human labels are absent. Project-page recordings are selected examples, not a complete run manifest.

Lineage counts conflict internally: the main construction description retains 696 of 2,380 journeys, while Appendix A.5 refers to 2,380 “refined journeys” as hard-task-generation inputs. The exact denominator and seed pool for the 80 generated hard tasks are unresolved. The README also says tasks always start at Google, but release inspection finds 130 Google starts and 70 other starting URLs.

Scoring has three risks. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview is a mutable preview judge without pinned API snapshot, temperature, seed, retry log, or cached outputs. Chronological screenshots and actions may omit hidden DOM state, saved-file correctness, off-screen evidence, and long-range side effects. Finally, public tasks omit generation-time rubric weights, making released scoring unweighted and preventing reproduction of any weighted internal QA state.

Replay is nondeterministic because live sites change and configs use no proxy or fixed IP. No site snapshots, exact OSWorld revision, VM/browser image, credentials, locale, reset manifest, or environment cache is released. Default omission of incomplete runs can inflate aggregates if crashes and timeouts are not explicitly failures.

Privacy protection includes reported consent, PII rewriting/removal, and withholding browser histories, but consent text, compensation, IRB status, retention/deletion, withdrawal, and privacy-audit details are unknown. Although tasks are intended to be read-only or low impact, agents have broad browser/VM capabilities; allowlists, credential isolation, download/malware controls, robots/ToS enforcement, and incident containment are undocumented. MIT covers repository code/data, not third-party site content or unreleased histories.

发布边界很大。原始参与者历史、筛选后的 696 条 journey 标签、逐项来源映射、拒绝决定、簇分配、完整成功与失败模型轨迹、截图、结果文件、Gemini 响应及人工标签均未公开；项目页录像只是精选示例，不是完整运行清单。

来源数量存在内部冲突：主要构造说明称从 2,380 条 journey 中保留 696 条，附录 A.5 却把 2,380 条“refined journeys”写成 hard 任务生成输入。80 个生成任务的精确分母和种子池尚未解决。README 还称任务总从 Google 开始，但公开数据实际包含 130 个 Google 起始任务和 70 个其他起始 URL。

评分有三类风险。Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview 是可变的 preview judge，没有固定 API 快照、温度、种子、重试日志或缓存输出。时序截图和动作可能看不到隐藏 DOM 状态、保存文件正确性、屏外证据或长程副作用。公开任务还缺少生成阶段的 rubric 权重，因此发布评分实际无权，无法复现任何内部加权 QA 状态。

由于实时网站会变化，且配置不使用代理或固定 IP，重放不具确定性。发布中没有站点快照、OSWorld 精确版本、VM/浏览器镜像、凭据、区域、重置清单或环境缓存。默认省略不完整运行，还可能在崩溃和超时未按失败计数时抬高汇总结果。

隐私保护包括作者报告的知情同意、PII 改写/移除及不公开浏览历史，但同意文本、报酬、IRB 状态、保留/删除、撤回和隐私审计细节未知。任务虽设计为只读或低影响，智能体仍有广泛浏览器/VM 能力；网络白名单、凭据隔离、下载/恶意软件控制、robots/ToS 执行和事故处置均未说明。MIT 仅覆盖仓库代码与数据，不涵盖第三方站点内容或未公开历史。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, Odysseys is useful as an evaluation specification for trajectories generated at run time. It connects a long-horizon prompt and starting URL to OSWorld environment configuration, ordered screenshots/actions, per-rubric judgments, partial score, perfect success, step count, and efficiency. This makes it suitable for evaluating frozen computer-use agents and studying failure localization.

It should not be listed as SFT, preference, reward-model, or RL training data: the released artifact has no paper-run episode corpus, and the paper describes rubric scores for evaluation. Using those scores for RL is future work. Researchers can nevertheless use the public tasks and scorer to collect a new, versioned trajectory corpus if they supply their own environment, agents, safety controls, and run retention policy.

Before comparative use, pin the task JSON and repository commit, preserve every complete and incomplete run, count crashes/timeouts as an explicit outcome, cache judge inputs/outputs, and record VM/browser/network state. For longitudinal evaluation, maintain feasibility checks and versioned replacements rather than silently editing tasks when websites drift.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 赛道而言，Odysseys 适合作为运行时生成轨迹的评测规范。它把长程提示和起始 URL 连接到 OSWorld 环境配置、时序截图/动作、逐 rubric 判断、部分得分、完全成功、步数和效率，因此适合评估冻结的 computer-use 智能体并研究失败定位。

它不应被列为 SFT、偏好、奖励模型或 RL 训练数据：发布制品没有论文实验回合语料，论文也只把 rubric 得分用于评测。用这些得分做 RL 仅是未来工作。不过，研究者可以基于公开任务和评分器自行采集有版本记录的新轨迹语料，前提是自行提供环境、智能体、安全控制和运行保留策略。

用于比较前，应固定任务 JSON 和仓库提交，保留所有完整与不完整运行，把崩溃/超时记为显式结果，缓存 judge 输入输出，并记录 VM、浏览器和网络状态。纵向评测应维护可行性检查和版本化替换，而不是在网站漂移时静默修改任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Sections 3–4 for the 200-task construction, 1,225-rubric contract, OSWorld execution loop, and Gemini per-rubric judge; read the appendices for filtering, human agreement, and 200-step scaling.
  • Keep the object boundary explicit: public task/rubric/config records are not the 2,380 source histories, 696 retained journeys, or complete model trajectories. training_use is evaluation only.
  • Audit scorer inputs and exclusions. Native OSWorld evaluation is infeasible, rubric weights are absent, and runs without numeric result.txt are skipped by default unless incomplete inclusion is requested.
  • Treat all live-web scores as versioned observations. Record start URL, site state, VM/browser/OSWorld revision, network identity, reset behavior, judge snapshot, every failed run, privacy protections, and VM security controls.

• 先读第 3–4 节，理解 200 个任务的构造、1,225 条 rubric 契约、OSWorld 执行循环和 Gemini 逐 rubric judge；附录提供筛选、人工一致性和 200 步扩展细节。
  • 明确对象边界：公开任务/rubric/配置记录不等于 2,380 条来源历史、696 条保留 journey 或完整模型轨迹；training_use 仅为 evaluation。
  • 审计评分器输入与排除规则。原生 OSWorld evaluator 为 infeasible，rubric 权重缺失；缺少数值型 result.txt 的运行默认被跳过，除非显式纳入 incomplete。
  • 把所有实时网页分数视为有版本的观察。应记录起始 URL、站点状态、VM/浏览器/OSWorld 修订、网络身份、重置行为、judge 快照、全部失败运行、隐私保护和 VM 安全控制。

value.html: The agent terminates voluntarily or reaches the step cap. Benchmark perfect success requires every rubric to be judged satisfied; blocked access is a failure under the released judge prompt. Default experiments cap at 100 steps, with selected 200-step scaling runs.

items: The preview Gemini judge can drift or be retired, and no exact API snapshot, temperature, seed, or cached judge response bundle is released.
Screenshots/actions may not expose hidden DOM/application state, saved-file correctness, off-screen content, or whether live facts remain valid.
Rubric-by-rubric binary calls reduce holistic overload but can produce inconsistent partial judgments across mutually dependent checkpoints.
The public JSON omits generation-time rubric weights, so released evaluation is effectively unweighted and cannot reproduce any weighted internal QA state.
Default omission of incomplete runs can inflate aggregates if crashes, timeouts, or absent result files are not explicitly counted as failures.
Observable-tab requirements may reward leaving pages open rather than robust evidence provenance, and judge-visible screenshots can miss citation quality.
预览版 Gemini 评审模型可能漂移或被下线，且未发布确切 API 快照、温度、种子或缓存的评审响应包。
截图/动作可能不暴露隐藏的 DOM/应用状态、已保存文件正确性、屏幕外内容，或实时事实是否仍然有效。
逐条评分标准的二元调用减少整体过载，但可能在相互依赖的检查点上产生不一致的部分判定。
公开 JSON 省略生成时评分标准权重，因此已发布评测实际上未加权，无法复现任何加权的内部 QA 状态。
若崩溃、超时或缺失结果文件未被显式计为失败，默认省略不完整运行可能抬高聚合值。
可观察标签页要求可能奖励让页面保持打开而非稳健的证据出处，且评审可见的截图可能遗漏引用质量。
Opus often researches until the step cap without creating the requested deliverable.
GPT-5.4 can produce a correct plan but terminate with an empty action before meaningful browser execution.
High-fanout tasks stall after a subset of items and leave later phases untouched.
Programmatic shortcuts can abandon useful browser progress and end with zero completed rubrics.
Live-site blocking, CAPTCHA, stale prices/schedules, regional content, and page redesign change feasibility and scores.
README's always-Google start claim conflicts with 70 released tasks using another start URL.
The exact seed denominator for hard-task generation is inconsistent between the main paper and Appendix A.5.
Reported results are author runs; no complete pinned replay or independent reproduction was verified.
Opus 经常研究直至步数上限而不创建所请求的交付物。
GPT-5.4 可产生正确计划但在有意义的浏览器执行之前以空动作终止。
高扇出任务在一部分条目之后停滞，并使后续阶段未被触及。
程序性捷径可能放弃有用的浏览器进展并以零条完成的评分标准结束。
实时站点阻断、CAPTCHA、过时价格/时刻表、地区内容与页面改版会改变可行性与分数。
README 的始终从 Google 开始的主张与 70 项使用其他起始 URL 的已发布任务冲突。
困难任务生成的精确种子分母在主论文与附录 A.5 之间不一致。
所报告结果为作者运行；未核验完整钉扎回放或独立复现。

This does not imply that source journeys, experimental run trajectories/results, frozen web state, human labels, or an end-to-end reproducibility package are public.

value_zh.html: 已核验论文、附录、任务/评分标准 JSON、200 个 OSWorld 配置、转换器、评测脚本、项目页面与 MIT 许可。这并不意味着来源旅程、实验运行轨迹/结果、冻结网页状态、人类标签或端到端可复现性包是公开的。
